Three extra columns of eight metatile IDs as read by $5056. The final room transfer can enter at a camera origin beyond the regular scroll limit, and its redraw expands these additional columns into the lookahead buffer.

Tail of a planar pattern in five-byte records aligned from $8EA4. Read the corresponding bit of each of the first four bytes as a four-bit index, most significant pixel first. The first three masks together cover all eight positions in each record. The fifth byte is zero, including the one at $8ED0 which completes the record starting at $8ECC. The last record starts at $8FDA and ends with two zero bytes at $8FDD–$8FDE.
Two zero bytes complete the planar record at $8FDA. These are the fourth mask and the zero fifth byte.

Character codes index this 256-byte flag table. The engine copies the selected byte to $19 in its tile sampler at $247D.
One colour value for each character code. The room renderer at $520E looks up the character it just wrote to screen RAM before writing the corresponding colour cell.
Values indexed by the hardware sprite pointer. The object sprite staging routine at $2DC8 copies the selected colour into its zero-page hardware update table.

Eight groups of four frames, with eight character rows in each frame. The updater at $1EA8 cycles the group every call and advances the frame after visiting the eighth group. It writes the selected rows into the character graphics at $EFD8–$EFFF.

This level reserves 8 eight-byte room descriptors before the first pointed-to list. The first big-endian pair offsets into the metatile map at $8A00. Byte three, counted from zero, contributes the right scroll limit. The last two pairs point to exits and objects relative to $A400.

Little-endian pointers. The first word points to the picture directory. Subsequent words select the entry and ending command streams for the level.

Command stream 0 for $454F. The dispatcher uses the first byte of each record. Commands select pictures, write $FF-terminated lines of text, position sprites and hold the scene. Zero returns from the drawing routine.

Retained story fragment referenced by opcode thirteen in the entry story. It contains eight draw-and-wait pairs. The C64 opcode-thirteen handler at $4732 advances past the reference and leaves this fragment unexecuted.

Story sprite frame sequence. Values below $FE select shapes, $FE holds a shape for the specified duration, and $FF rewinds the stream by a word offset. This span occupies $AD2E–$AD6F.
Story sprite motion sequence. A normal pair combines an update count with two signed motion nibbles. A zero command takes a little-endian continuation address. This span occupies $AD70–$AD91.
Story sprite frame sequence. Values below $FE select shapes, $FE holds a shape for the specified duration, and $FF rewinds the stream by a word offset. This span occupies $AD92–$AE1F.
